simulations.title: Same events, different assignment
simulations.description: Watch the Kafka lag and five idle readers; SNS delivers a full copy to each subscription.

action.text: Kafka assigns three of eight replicas. Each SNS subscription can use all eight; subscriptions receive independent copies.

simulations.title: Give every reader a partition
simulations.description: Eight partitions remove the assignment bottleneck without changing the reader fleets.

action.text: Only the Kafka partition count changed. SNS has no partition setting.
